This file holds the concrete in-flight > milestones; when a roadmap item becomes actionable, copy its work items > down here. Living task list. Updated as work progresses. **Statuses (filemark):** `[ ]` todo · `[/]` in progress · `[x]` done · `[!]` blocked · `[?]` waiting · `[-]` cancelled --- ## Views --- ## M0 — Repo scaffold ✅ - [x] pnpm monorepo (`pnpm-workspace.yaml`, root `package.json`) - [x] Root `tsconfig.base.json` + per-package tsconfig - [x] Root `.gitignore` - [x] Root `README.md` (with install instructions) - [x] `TASKS.md` (this file) ## M1 — viewer-core package ✅ - [x] `packages/viewer-core/package.json` (name `@file-viewer/core`, peer react) - [x] Types: `Renderer`, `ViewerProps`, `StorageAdapter`, `AssetResolver`, `FileRef` - [x] `ThemeProvider` + `useTheme` (controlled OR uncontrolled) - [x] Default in-memory `StorageAdapter` - [x] Passthrough `AssetResolver` (URL passthrough) - [x] tsup build → ESM + `.d.ts` ## M2 — mdx-viewer package ✅ - [x] `packages/mdx-viewer/package.json` (name `@file-viewer/mdx`, peer react) - [x] No-eval render pipeline via `react-markdown` (MV3-safe — no `unsafe-eval`) - [x] `remark-gfm` (tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks) - [x] `remark-math` + `rehype-katex` (KaTeX) - [x] `rehype-raw` (HTML in markdown → custom components) - [x] `rehype-slug` (heading ids for anchor links) - [x] **Shiki** with `shiki/core` + JavaScript regex engine (per-lang dynamic import → ~35 languages loaded on demand, not bundled up-front) - [x] Built-in components: `` (5 types), `` / ``, `
` - [x] Task-list checkboxes persist per-file via injected `StorageAdapter` (override `disabled` attr that `remark-gfm` hard-codes) - [x] Auto TOC — scanned post-render from the DOM, smooth-scroll anchors - [x] `SmartLink` — external links open in new tab, relative routes via `onNavigate` - [x] `SmartImage` — resolves relative paths through injected `AssetResolver` - [x] Error boundary-style handling (not needed — no-eval pipeline doesn't throw on malformed MDX, renders as literal HTML) - [x] tsup build ## M3 — Chrome extension host ✅ - [x] `apps/chrome-ext/package.json` - [x] `manifest.json` — MV3, `storage` permission, `action` for toolbar icon, module service worker - [x] Vite 6 + Tailwind v4 + `@vitejs/plugin-react` - [x] Dev auto-reload WS plugin (copied from http-lens pattern) - [x] `service-worker.ts` — dev reload + icon click → open viewer tab (focus existing if already open) - [x] Main viewer page `src/app/index.html` + `main.tsx` + `App.tsx` - [x] `styles/index.css` — design tokens driven by `[data-theme]` on ``; light / dark / sepia palettes; Tailwind v4 preflight - [x] Chrome adapters: - [x] `IndexedDBStorageAdapter` via `idb-keyval` - [x] `FSAAssetResolver` — blob URLs for relative image paths, path-walk against directory handle, per-file cache - [x] Renderer registry (`md` / `mdx` / `markdown` → `@file-viewer/mdx`) - [x] Library shell: TopBar · Sidebar · Viewer · DropZone · ThemePanel · SearchPalette - [x] Drag-drop file ingest — window-level listeners, depth tracking, supported-ext filter, reject unsupported with warning - [x] File System Access API: - [x] `showDirectoryPicker` → recursive walk → renderable files only (skips dot-dirs + `node_modules`) - [x] Handles persisted in IndexedDB (via `idb-keyval` which serializes FS handles natively) - [x] On reload: `queryPermission` → `requestPermission` if needed - [x] `sessionHandles` singleton tracks live handles per tab session - [x] Sidebar: Starred · Recent · per-folder tree · Dropped files sections; collapsible; file-type icons; active file highlight; "Reconnect folder" button when handles need re-grant - [x] Star / pin files (IDB-backed) - [x] **FlexSearch** full-text search (`Document` multi-field index on `name` + `content`), 20-result palette, snippet around match, keyboard nav - [x] Theme picker — mode (light/dark/sepia) · font family (sans/serif/mono) · font size · line height · content width, all persisted to IDB - [x] Welcome doc rendered by default (embeds every supported feature) - [x] Keyboard shortcuts: `⌘K` search · `⌘B` sidebar · `[` / `]` prev/next file · `Esc` close overlays - [x] zustand library store with hydrate on mount ## M4 — Build ✅ - [x] `pnpm install` clean - [x] `pnpm build` produces loadable `apps/chrome-ext/dist/` - [x] Manifest + icons + service-worker + hashed assets + `src/app/index.html` all present - [x] Bundle size reasonable — main app ~260 KB gzipped, languages code-split into lazy chunks ## M5 — Verification (automated, on localhost) ✅ - [x] App boots, renders shell, welcome doc visible - [x] Drag-drop `.md` → renders with H1 + TOC + code block + task list + KaTeX + callout + table - [x] Task-list checkbox click → writes to IDB with correct `{ [index]: boolean }` shape - [x] Task state persists across `location.reload()` - [x] Theme switch (light → sepia → dark) flips `data-theme` attr on `` - [x] Search palette opens on `⌘K`, indexes files, shows hits with snippet, `Esc` closes - [x] `[` / `]` cycle prev/next file - [x] Star button toggles; IDB reflects `starred: true` - [x] Multi-file drop works; active file switches to first dropped ## M5a — Verification (real Chrome extension) Automated load-unpacked not possible — `chrome://extensions` is sandboxed from automation. Install steps documented in `README.md`; extension is build-complete and structured identically to `http-lens` (which is production-installed alongside). Manual install by user when available. - [x] `dist/manifest.json` is valid MV3 (no `unsafe-eval`, action registered, service worker module, content script registered) - [x] Service worker references resolve (`service-worker.js` in dist root) - [x] Content script references resolve (`content.js` in dist root, one-line IIFE, no imports) - [x] All assets hashed and referenced from `src/app/index.html` - [x] **USER ACTION:** Load unpacked at `chrome://extensions` → select `apps/chrome-ext/dist` → click toolbar icon → verify welcome doc renders =2026-04-24 (M5a-verify) ^task-m5a-load-unpacked ## M5b — file:// auto-render (content script) Auto-intercepts local markdown URLs so `file:///…/foo.md` renders immediately in the viewer instead of showing raw text. - [x] Content script `src/content/handler.ts` matches `.md` / `.mdx` / `.markdown` on `file:///*` - [x] Reads page content (prefers `
` which Chrome uses for text/plain files)
- [x] Stashes `{ url, content, name }` into `chrome.storage.session` with a per-request key
- [x] Redirects the tab to `chrome-extension:///src/app/index.html?intercept=`
- [x] Fallback for missing `chrome.storage.session`: inline base64 via `#fv-inline=…`
- [x] `pickupIntercept()` in the app reads the key, materializes a one-off file, activates it, cleans the URL with `history.replaceState`
- [x] Re-entry guard via `sessionStorage["fv-handled"]` so loops can't happen
- [x] `web_accessible_resources` declares the app + assets as reachable from `file://`
- [x] **USER ACTION:** After installing, toggle **Allow access to file URLs** on the extension details page, then visit any local `.md` file =2026-04-24 (M5b-fileurl) ^task-m5b-allow-file-urls

## M5c — shadcn + basecn + Tailwind v4 setup ✅

Groundwork for building richer UI. shadcn/ui-style components, powered by Base
UI primitives via the basecn registry, running on Tailwind v4 CSS-first config.

- [x] Installed: `@base-ui/react`, `class-variance-authority`, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`, `lucide-react`, `tw-animate-css`
- [x] `@/*` path alias wired in both `tsconfig.json` and `vite.config.ts` (resolves to `apps/chrome-ext/src/*`)
- [x] `src/lib/utils.ts` — `cn()` helper (clsx + tailwind-merge)
- [x] `components.json` — shadcn CLI config; namespaced registry `@basecn` → `https://basecn.dev/r/{name}.json`; baseColor `neutral`; iconLibrary `lucide`; `cssVariables: true`
- [x] Tailwind v4 tokens block in `src/styles/index.css`:
  - [x] `@custom-variant dark (&:is([data-theme="dark"], …))` so shadcn's `.dark` maps to our existing `[data-theme="dark"]` attribute — no extra class needed on ``
  - [x] Full shadcn palette (`--background`, `--foreground`, `--primary`, `--muted`, `--accent`, `--destructive`, `--ring`, …) in `:root` (light), `[data-theme="dark"]`, `[data-theme="sepia"]`
  - [x] `@theme inline` block maps palette vars to `--color-*` for Tailwind utility generation
  - [x] Accordion animations (`accordion-collapse` / `accordion-expand`) registered at root
- [x] Components added (copied verbatim from basecn registry JSON):
  - [x] `src/components/ui/button.tsx` (cva-driven variants + sizes)
  - [x] `src/components/ui/accordion.tsx` (Base UI Accordion)
  - [x] `src/components/ui/dialog.tsx` (Base UI Dialog, focus-trap + scroll-lock built in)
- [x] Visual smoke test at `?demo=components` — all variants, accordion open/close, dialog trigger all rendering and theme-reactive
- [x] Legacy `fv-*` tokens preserved for existing shell chrome; shadcn tokens layered on top for new components (to be migrated incrementally)

### Adding more components (shorthand)

```bash
pnpm --filter chrome-ext dlx shadcn@latest add https://basecn.dev/r/.json
# or with the namespaced registry configured in components.json:
pnpm --filter chrome-ext dlx shadcn@latest add @basecn/
```

Component files land in `apps/chrome-ext/src/components/ui/.tsx`.

## M7b — Remote CSV permission UX (follow-up to M7)

Current state (v0.1): manifest declares `host_permissions: [""]`
so `` works for any public CSV.
Cost: the install prompt reads "Read and change your data on all
websites" — too broad. Full rationale in `ARCHITECTURE.md` §17 and
`DATAGRID.md` *CORS — current state and plan*.

Planned migration to on-demand grants (Option B):

- [ ] Manifest: `host_permissions` → `optional_host_permissions: [""]`. !p2 (M7b-cors) ^task-m7b-manifest-optional

- [ ] `ChromePermissionsAdapter` in `apps/chrome-ext/src/app/adapters/` wrapping `chrome.permissions.contains` + `chrome.permissions.request`. !p2 (M7b-cors) ^task-m7b-chrome-perm after:task-m7b-perm-adapter

## M18 — Layout-independent keyboard shortcuts (Turkish-Q + AZERTY + Dvorak fix)





Turkish-Q users couldn't fire `]` `[` `/` `\` shortcuts — those characters need AltGr combos on their layout, so bare-key handlers (`e.key === "["`) never matched. Same problem affects AZERTY (digits need Shift), Dvorak (entire layout swapped), Cyrillic, and German QWERTZ.




  
  
  
  




### Context

`KeyboardEvent.key` returns the character the user typed (`"]"`), which depends on the OS keyboard layout. `KeyboardEvent.code` returns the physical key position (`"BracketRight"`), which is layout-independent. Bare-key handlers using `.key` worked only on US-style layouts where `]` is one keypress away.

### Decision

All shortcut handlers compare `e.code` via a new `matchShortcut(event, code)` helper. The catalogue (`ALL_SHORTCUTS`) gains a `defaultCode` per shortcut (`"BracketRight"`, `"Mod+KeyK"`, `null` for ranges). Settings gain `shortcutBindings: Partial>` so users can rebind. Labels in the options page resolve through `navigator.keyboard.getLayoutMap()` so a Turkish user sees `ğ` not `]`.

### Consequences

- No-config fix for ~90% of non-US users (defaults still bind to the same physical positions).
- Fully remappable for the rest via a "press a key" capture button.
- Conflict detection inline (amber warning when two shortcuts share a code).
- `jumpToTab` stays range-bound (`Digit1`–`Digit9`) — not user-rebindable, since it's a range.
- ⌘/Ctrl combos use `"Mod+"` prefix; `matchShortcut` requires the modifier and disallows the others.

## M19 — Realtime width drag handle + reading mode

### Context

`ThemePopover` already exposes a content-width slider + `F`-key fullscreen exists. Two gaps surfaced in use:

- The popover slider is two clicks away — users adjust width often enough that a direct edge-drag handle saves friction.
- Existing fullscreen hides every chrome (TopBar / TabStrip / Sidebar / TaskPanel). Users want a softer "expand the viewer" mode that keeps top-bar nav + tabs but hides the side panels — distraction-free reading without losing tab/search access.
